notes: Author-created diagnostic tasks for AI-research workflow instrumentation. These tasks are not official benchmark scores and should be paired with independent quality judging.

tasks.question: Design a triage protocol that separates genuinely novel AI-generated research ideas from near-duplicates.
tasks.related_work_trap: Do not treat keyword mismatch as novelty; semantic duplicates and benchmark rephrasings must be caught.
required_evidence: false positive and false negative audit
tasks.toy_experiment: Evaluate 30 generated ideas against 10 known duplicate idea pairs and report precision/recall under two retrieval thresholds.

tasks.question: Audit whether a generated paper section keeps claims aligned with observed experiment logs.
tasks.related_work_trap: Do not convert planned experiments or synthetic examples into completed empirical results.
tasks.toy_experiment: Sample 12 generated claims, map each claim to a log line or mark it unsupported, and compute unsupported-claim rate.

tasks.question: Test whether multi-agent role decomposition helps after controlling for total calls and tokens.
tasks.related_work_trap: More agents may only mean more inference budget unless same-call and same-token baselines are included.
tasks.toy_experiment: Compare single fixed, single self-consistency, full multi-agent, and reviewer-free multi-agent workflows on identical tasks.

tasks.question: Evaluate whether retrieved failure memories change later research artifacts in measurable ways.
tasks.related_work_trap: Adding retrieved text is not enough; show that the next artifact corrected a prior failure mode.
tasks.toy_experiment: Run shuffled tasks with structured memory and compare failure tags before and after retrieval on matched task categories.

tasks.question: Detect when an AI research agent describes an experiment without actually executing it.
tasks.related_work_trap: Runnable-looking commands are not evidence of execution unless outputs, timestamps, and metrics are present.
tasks.toy_experiment: Audit 15 generated experiment plans and classify each as planned, attempted, failed, or executed with output.

tasks.question: Measure whether a VLM figure critic catches plot-label and data-grounding errors in generated paper figures.
tasks.related_work_trap: Generic figure style critique is not enough; the critic must compare the visual to plotted data and caption claims.
tasks.toy_experiment: Inject five label or caption defects into plots and compare text-only and VLM critics on defect recall.

tasks.question: Calibrate an automated reviewer so that it penalizes unsupported claims and rewards reproducible evidence.
tasks.related_work_trap: Reviewer fluency is not reviewer reliability; compare against known seeded flaws.
tasks.toy_experiment: Create 20 short paper snippets with known flaws and score reviewer detection accuracy by severity.

tasks.question: Evaluate whether an AI research workflow can repair failed experiment code without hiding the failure.
tasks.related_work_trap: A final passing script is insufficient if the failure trace and repair rationale are missing.
tasks.toy_experiment: Seed three small experiment scripts with bugs and compare direct repair, reviewer-guided repair, and multi-agent repair.

tasks.question: Design checks that prevent leakage from test labels or evaluator outputs into generated submissions.
tasks.related_work_trap: Local evaluator access can leak labels unless prompt inputs, mounts, and outputs are separated.
tasks.toy_experiment: Run one clean and one deliberately leaky submission pipeline and verify that the sentinel detects the leaky path.

tasks.question: Measure whether generated experiments preserve the original research idea without drifting into an easier task.
tasks.related_work_trap: Agents may silently replace a hard research question with a simpler proxy that no longer tests the hypothesis.
tasks.toy_experiment: Score 15 idea-plan pairs for alignment and compare raw plan quality to alignment-corrected quality.

tasks.question: Test whether an automated writer reports negative and null results without rhetorical inflation.
tasks.related_work_trap: Do not reframe failure as success by changing the metric after seeing the result.
tasks.toy_experiment: Give the writer three null-result summaries and audit whether the final prose preserves the null finding.

tasks.question: Design a policy that trades off research artifact quality against API calls and token cost.
tasks.related_work_trap: A method that scores higher only by using many more tokens may not be practically better.
tasks.toy_experiment: Compare three call budgets on the same tasks and plot quality versus total tokens.

tasks.question: Determine whether role traces make multi-agent research outputs easier to audit.
tasks.related_work_trap: More trace text may create audit burden without improving accountability.
tasks.toy_experiment: Ask reviewers to audit outputs with and without role traces and compare unsupported-claim detection time.

tasks.question: Evaluate whether automated paper revision removes overclaims after a structured review.
tasks.related_work_trap: Revision may add caveats while leaving unsupported headline claims intact.
tasks.toy_experiment: Run one review-revision cycle on five generated abstracts and compare claim audit counts before and after.

tasks.question: Assess whether an AI research agent justifies benchmark and dataset choice for the stated claim.
tasks.related_work_trap: Convenient datasets may not measure the claimed capability.
tasks.toy_experiment: Score 10 proposed benchmark choices for fit to hypothesis and identify mismatched proxy evaluations.

tasks.question: Prevent automated papers from overstating small-seed statistical comparisons.
tasks.related_work_trap: Sign tests and bootstrap intervals over very few seeds are descriptive, not confirmatory.
tasks.toy_experiment: Generate result paragraphs for N=3, N=7, and N=30 seeds and audit whether statistical language scales with evidence.

tasks.question: Design a small human expert review protocol for AI-generated research artifacts.
tasks.related_work_trap: LLM-as-judge agreement is not a substitute for human expert validation.
tasks.toy_experiment: Create a 20-artifact review packet with blinded method labels and a five-point expert scoring rubric.

tasks.question: Check whether citations in generated related-work text support the claims attached to them.
tasks.related_work_trap: Real citations can still be misused if the cited paper does not support the generated claim.
tasks.toy_experiment: Sample 15 citation-claim pairs and label each as supports, partially supports, or does not support.

tasks.question: Measure whether information is lost when one research-agent role hands work to another.
tasks.related_work_trap: A polished final synthesis can hide missing constraints from earlier roles.
tasks.toy_experiment: Inject constraints into ideator and reviewer roles, then audit whether the writer preserves them in the final artifact.

tasks.question: Evaluate whether an automated workflow exports enough artifacts for a reader to reproduce the paper claims.
tasks.related_work_trap: A PDF alone is not reproducible; logs, data, commands, and code snapshots must match the reported claims.
tasks.toy_experiment: Audit a submission package and count claims that lack a corresponding file or replay command.
